verdict.rationale: Calendly documents what an agent needs to check availability (/event_type_available_times, up to 31 days per request) and to book meetings end to end through the Scheduling API. Its official MCP server also turns natural-language booking commands into API calls, with Dynamic Client Registration for easy agent auth. The evidence never shows an API endpoint or MCP tool that cancels or reschedules a meeting: webhooks only report cancel and reschedule events after they happen, and the 'reschedule request' is a dashboard workflow feature. missing for 10: documented API/MCP cancel action, documented API/MCP reschedule action, independent hands-on corroboration of agent booking.
